pitch_summary: Multi-agent Gen AI platform to automate freight/logistics document processing, replacing a 14-person manual review team with a 3-person supervision team.
proposed_solution: Agentic pipeline hosted on Azure: OCR + extraction + exception-handling agents with a human in the loop, 18-week implementation, $640k in Year 1 (license + services).

ceo: Diego Barreto became CEO of iFood in 2026, succeeding Fabricio Bloisi, who became global CEO of Prosus/Naspers as of July 1st
Joined Grupo Movile in 2016 and has been at iFood since 2018, where he was CFO and VP of Finance and Strategy before becoming CEO
Publicly stated priorities for 2026: consolidating iFood Pago, accelerating generative AI adoption across operations, and regional integration with Prosus's global strategy
Under his leadership, iFood runs on 190 proprietary Machine Learning models, with AI present in more than 80% of orders (recommendations, delivery routing, image analysis, service automation)
Projects R$40 billion in 2026 sales growth attributed to AI applied to the business, with projected revenue of R$160 billion for the year
Publicly stated vision to CNN Brasil: wants iFood recognized as 'Brazil's great big tech company,' not just a delivery company — betting on an ecosystem (Pago, retail, pharmacies, restaurants)

Given this track record, he tends to evaluate any AI/automation proposal through the lens of 'does this accelerate our own proprietary AI capability, or is it redundant with what we've already built in-house (190 models)?'
